svg.title: How an enzyme builds a fatty acid.
svg.desc: From hepatic regulation to repeated elongation, product release and kinetic inference.
svg.text: How an enzyme builds a fatty acid.
From hepatic regulation to repeated elongation, product release and kinetic inference.
Metabolic switching at the network scale; chain-length dynamics at the enzyme scale.
Reaction scheme • carrier and enzyme geometry are symbolic, not a protein structure.
